## 13/09/2026 20:41 — MoPr06 DocMerge Pro Review

Partner, completed the **product + code + documentation + market-demand + enterprise-readiness review** and created the requested V001 workbook.

### Verdict

**Market demand: YES — strong, but highly competitive.** The category is unquestionably real: autoCrat alone shows **83M+ installs**, while Form Publisher shows **24M+**, and Document Studio already competes with broad document automation/integration capabilities. citeturn0search2turn0search3turn0search4

**Enterprise-grade today: NO.** I scored current enterprise readiness at **5.5/10**. The engineering foundation is substantially stronger than an ordinary MVP, particularly tenant isolation, authorization hardening, purge controls, bounded ledgers and quota handling. The supplied material itself documents that 100% coverage previously failed to catch serious authorization/integration defects, which is an important lesson now captured in the guard kit. fileciteturn0file1L7-L11

The biggest issue is that **code completeness ≠ launch readiness**. Your own state document says all 100 backlog stories are complete and reports **836 tests at 100% coverage**, but also explicitly says the product cannot yet launch. fileciteturn0file2L10-L15

I also found a concrete release blocker in the code review: the GitHub Actions deployment stage is still effectively a **placeholder**, rather than a real production deployment pipeline.

Google also requires public Marketplace applications to pass its publication/review process, with OAuth verification required where applicable. citeturn0search0turn0search10

### Enhancement roadmap

I created **20 additional build/validation sprints, S13–S32**, covering surface freeze, reproducible releases, real GCP staging, OAuth/Marketplace verification, enterprise SSO/admin controls, durable multi-tenant state, distributed quota-aware jobs, security/pentest, governance, audit/compliance, DR, SRE, billing, accessibility, competitive differentiation, scale testing, support operations, paid design partners, Marketplace GA and post-GA enterprise expansion.

The workbook also gives Claude an explicit **Definition of Done** so it cannot treat "100% tests passed" as equivalent to "enterprise-ready."

**Overall assessment: 6.4/10 today — BUILD, but do not market it as enterprise-grade yet.**

### Download

[**chatgpt_review_V001_MoPr06-docmerge_pro_gws_20260913_2041.xlsx**](sandbox:/mnt/data/chatgpt_review_V001_MoPr06-docmerge_pro_gws_20260913_2041.xlsx)

It contains **Executive Review, Market Demand, Findings, S13–S32 Sprint Plan, Claude Instructions, Enterprise Scorecard, and Evidence Register**.
